Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in statistics rows H46:L47 causing test failure in test_derived_values_and_stats.
The test_legacy_pytest_suite failed due to an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, assert_matrix reported '#NAME?' errors for cells H46 through L47, where numeric statistical values were expected. This error typically indicates an undefined name, a misspelled function, or a missing range reference in the generated Excel workbook.
